observations: Revision 6 durably authorizes a secondary concurrent writer.
The primary remains designated and owns PR 258 plus the existing native Run.
Branch and Run isolation are mandatory collision boundaries for this execution.

local_learn.reason: One ownership transition does not justify changing a reusable component prompt.

result.ambitious_end_goal: Genuine real-world AGI exists; no repository milestone, internal test, CI result, architecture claim, or self-assessment is sufficient evidence by itself.
constraints: Keep the designated Claude session primary unless the user changes that designation.
Do not mutate PR 258, its branch, the primary lease, or run-work-mode-handoff-v2.
Do not expose secrets or claim AGI without real supporting evidence.
Serialize eventual main integration with exact-head validation and fresh-main conflict checks.
immediate_blockers: No secondary unit has yet been selected; current strategy and open work are method-family concentrated and several obvious tasks already have active PR owners.
The checked-in Work policy still assumes a single writer, so this run must remain branch-isolated until a safe parallel coordination contract is proven or the primary integrates it.
result.next_falsifiable_milestone: Inspect latest main and existing open PR scopes, then implement a branch-isolated parallel-execution safety boundary that prevents duplicate Run/invocation ownership and file-scope collision, or select a more valuable non-overlapping capability unit if evidence shows coordination work would be overhead.
result.objective: Operate as a user-authorized secondary parallel O development writer and reduce expected elapsed time to genuine AGI through independent, non-overlapping, reviewable work while the designated Claude primary continues.

success_conditions.condition: The secondary writer selects and completes a falsifiable unit that does not overlap PR 258, the primary branch, the primary native Run, or its pending invocation.
success_conditions.required_evidence: Latest-main inspection, explicit scope exclusion, distinct branch, distinct run_id, and a changed-file comparison against current primary work.

success_conditions.condition: The unit produces decision-changing capability or negative evidence relevant to expected time to AGI.
success_conditions.required_evidence: Mechanical focused tests plus a protected regression boundary; retain failures and unsupported hypotheses.

success_conditions.condition: Work is published without corrupting concurrent primary work.
success_conditions.required_evidence: Isolated branch/PR, exact-head remote readback, fresh-main conflict check, and no force-push, merge, rerun, cancellation, or mutation of the primary PR/head.

success_conditions.condition: User directions revision 5 and revision 6 remain effective.
success_conditions.required_evidence: Repository-side execution requiring no terminal steps from the smartphone-only user, and durable revision-6 readback on main.
